newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish budget gap to cost above 40 bln pta/yr-Rat.
newsitem.headline: Spanish budget gap to cost above 40 bln pta/yr-Rat.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday Spain would pay some 40 billion pesetas annually in interest for new debt issuance to cover the 721 billion peseta 1995 budget hole detected this summer.

"The financial charge that this additional debt generates is estimated to be about 40 billion pesetas in a full year to which one would have to add the quantities which go to pay the principal fee," Rato told Congress.
The legislature is set to ratify a law granting extraordinary loans to cover the budget gap.
